I look on him as a sort of salvation. I am not the only one. The '''Lead Cloning Technician''' was an Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Species/Legends|race]] that developed the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. At the time when the Lead Cloning Technician was stationed on [[Timira City]], Kamino had long since lost its freedom; its people became obligated to serve the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Under the Technician's observation, the Imperials eventually developed the "accelerated cloning process," a procedure that engineered [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Clone stormtrooper|clones]] at a much faster rate than the Kaminoan method and [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti technology]]. At the behest of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the Technician was placed in charge of a clandestine project: the creation of a perfect clone of [[Galen Marek]], Vader's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]] who [[Death/Legends|perished]] in an [[Battle on Death Star I|act]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebellion]] against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Order of the Sith Lords|Order]].

==History==
{{Quote|We are still left with hundreds upon hundreds of abject failures. While they no longer try to kill anything that comes near them, they are nearly insensible.|Lead Cloning Technician, Timira City Cloning Facility|<ref name="TFU2vg" />}}
[[File:TFUII-concept_5.png|thumb|left|250px|Within Timira City, the Lead Cloning Technician struggled for months to create the perfect clone of Galen Marek.]]
The Lead Cloning Technician of [[Timira City]], a [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Timira City Cloning Facility|cloning facility]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], was tasked with a seemingly impossible task in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]: the creation of a stable [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]].<ref>The ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' databank's perspective takes place before and possibly during the events of ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' project, which happens in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''The Force Unleashed II'' comic]].</ref><ref name="TFU2vg" /> At the time, there had never been a known successful attempt to clone a subject who was strongly connected to the power of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Although the exact reason was unknown, it was generally assumed that the Force was somehow responsible for the instabilities that undermined the development of Force-sensitive clones.<ref name="TFU2n">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], was determined to achieve the impossible, and thus the Lead Cloning Technician was assigned to engineer the first successful clone of a Force-sensitive subject.<ref name="TFU2vg" /> The [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]], from which the Force-induced [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] would be extracted from, was the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] body of [[Galen Marek]],<ref name="DT">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'': "Distant Thunder" cutscenes</ref> a former [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] who once served Darth Vader under the codename of "Starkiller."<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> The motive behind Vader's actions was the assassination of his own [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], an act which he was incapable of achieving on his own.<ref name="TFU2n" /> As such, the operation to duplicate Marek's genetic code was classified and conducted within the secret laboratories of Timira City. In order to prevent Marek's DNA from becoming compromised by the natural process of decomposition, the former secret apprentice's corpse was frozen and preserved within a secret chamber in Timira City, thus preventing it from rotting.<ref name="DT" /> Although the Lead Cloning Technician desired greater access to the template itself, Darth Vader alone possessed unrestricted access.<ref name="TFU2 databank" />

The flaws within the accelerated cloning process, combined with the inherent difficulty of replicating an exact copy of a Force-sensitive subject's genetic code with perfect precision, essentially made the project a frustrating series of "trial and error" attempts. After roughly six months since the project began, Timira City's laboratories were filled with hundreds of [[Aberrant clone|aberrant monstrosities]], completely unstable and utterly deranged in mind. Through unyielding determination and labor, the Lead Cloning Technician slowly but steadily corrected the various mistakes, which eventually led to more stable subjects.<ref name="TFU2 databank" /><ref name="TFU2vg" />

[[File:Starkiller_clones.png|thumb|right|250px|The accelerated cloning process, an initially imperfect procedure, resulted in hundreds of aberrant failures.]]
As further attempts to clone Marek gradually led to greater progress, the frequency and intensity of instabilities became increasingly rare with each clone. Physical deformities were eliminated, and thus the improved clones bore an exact physical resemblance to their genetic donor at the time of his death. Yet while the physical aspect was corrected, the unstable minds of the clones remained a dilemma for some time. The clones that Darth Vader personally [[Sith training|trained]] proved too inadequate to replace Marek at the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] side. The primary factor behind their collective failure was Marek's own mind. The apprentice's memories had been [[Memory flash|downloaded]] into the clones as a form of [[flash training]], thus enabling them to utilize their genetically inherited [[Force power/Legends|gifts]] almost immediately after their creation.<ref name="DT" /><ref name="TFU2vg" />

But the clones acquired more than just the knowledge of Marek's skills due to the memory imprints; they gained the memories of his life and experiences, as well as certain emotional attachments. Ultimately, however, some clones were emotionally different than others. During their training in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] against [[Sith Training Droid]]s, certain clones refused to destroy the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that were disguised as Marek's [[Kento Marek|long dead father]]. Other clones were too distracted by memories of the child that their progenitor had once been.<ref name="TFU2n" /> The Lead Cloning Technician observed one particular clone who was unable to attack a Sith Training Droid. Although the subject struck down every [[Hologram/Legends|camouflaged]] droid without hesitation, an undisguised droid triggered the memory of [[PROXY]], due to its similar appearance to the apprentice's [[Holodroid/Legends|holodroid]] friend.<ref name="TFU2 databank" />

As the project neared its end, only two clones proved to be more stable than those that preceded them: the so-called [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] and the [[Dark Apprentice]]. Although the two were virtually identical in various ways, only the latter proved worthy to become the new disciple of Darth Vader.<ref name="TFU2vg" /><ref name="TFU2 databank" /> Starkiller, the clone who eventually became known by his progenitor's former codename, succeeded in his trials to the point where Vader assumed that he would be the first success in a very long line of failures. But as with the others who became compromised by certain emotional attachments due to the memory imprints, Starkiller was ultimately deemed as yet another disappointment because of his obsession with [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] whom Marek fell in love with. This obsession caused the clone to rebel against his Master by [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaping]] from Kamino in order to locate Eclipse.<ref name="TFU2vg" />

[[File:VaderDarkApprenticeMarekBody-TFU2.png|thumb|left|220px|Darth Vader allows the Dark Apprentice, the Lead Cloning Technician's greatest creation, to view the dead body of Galen Marek.]]
The clone who became Darth Vader's "Dark Apprentice" proved to be far greater and more impressive than his renegade "brother," as well as the rest of his imperfect precursors. Although his rate of progress impressed both Vader and the Technician who observed his development, the clone was initially troubled as the others were, but to a lesser degree. Early signs of his inherent weaknesses included the first memory he experienced upon his decanting&mdash;a memory of Juno Eclipse. In spite of his initial curiosity about her whereabouts, the clone maintained a steady focus on the objective of passing his trials without error. Nevertheless, he still experienced the same identity crisis that drove his brothers to [[Clone madness|madness]], but eventually overcame the side-effects after compartmentalizing Marek's memories, an action which allowed him to distinguish his own experiences from those of Marek.<ref name="TFU2 databank" /><ref name="DT" />

The clone's rate of success astounded the shocked Lead Cloning Technician, who finally concluded that the project was finally ready to be deemed a success. With the project's conclusion, the Technician anticipated an opportunity to leave Kamino for home. By this time, the results of the entire project had been recorded onto the Technician's personal entry logs in the form of a private journal. In the aftermath of the [[Assault on Kamino]], fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the Galactic Empire, the Technician's notes were found in the garbage processing facility on [[Kamino Station X]].<ref name="TFU2 databank" />

==Personality and traits==
The Lead Cloning Technician found the aberrant clones' meaningless gibbering to be extremely disturbing. The constant rate of failures greatly vexed the Technician, who hoped in vain for greater access to the source of the Force-sensitive genetic material. Having become accustomed to a steady series of one disappointment after another, the Technician was joyously elated and encouraged by the progress made by the Dark Apprentice, a clone who succeeded where all of the others failed. All of the Technician's hopes became invested in the final outcome of the dark clone, and thus it was the Technician's great hope that the project would finally be concluded after months of laborious, error-filled procedures. Furthermore, the Technician was also eager to complete Darth Vader's project in order to return to home and family.<ref name="TFU2 databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lead Cloning Technician's logs appear in the in-game Databank of the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''.
